[i]The Borderlands of Coober Pedi is currently dominated by three political parties.

[b]The Social Democratic Liberal Party of the Democracy[/b], the dominant party, who aim to continue Coober Pedi's reputation of giving power to the people, so that they can do anything they set their hearts to, and they deem freedom of assembly essential. This party was founded in 1915.

The new and steadily growing party, [b]The Nationalistic Conservative Party of the Authoritative State[/b], is proud of its country's achievements, strengthened by the election of the current [b]Prime Minister of the Borderlands of Coober Pedi[/b], [b]Edward Joseph[/b], in 2023. They aim to make it more powerful and safer by revolutionizing the military and police, while enacting crueler punishments. They also aim to give more power to the Federal Government. This party was founded in 2019, following the election of a weak Prime Minister.

[b]The Green Coalition of the Borderlands of Coober Pedi[/b] is an independent[ish] alliance of two political parties since 2005 with similar goals: cultural understanding of cultures within and outside the borders of Coober Pedi and green politics aiming at restoring and maintaining the environment via the native Aboriginal ways. The two parties that make up the Coalition are [b]The Inoffensive Independent Party of the Borderlands[/b], who aim to serve the people instead of a party, and [b]The Centrist Libertarian Party of Coober Pedi[/b], which aims to be the "middle" party, in-between The Social Democratic Liberal Party of the Democracy and The Nationalistic Conservative Party of the Authoritative State. Both of these parties that make up The Green Coalition of the Borderlands of Coober Pedi were founded in 1945 in response to the Nobles' War in the United Regions of Nordiheim.

The current party leader of The Social Democratic Party of the Democracy is the current president of Coober Pedi, Edward Joseph. The Nationalistic Conservative Party of the Authoritative State considers Edward Joseph a fine leader, so they don't have a single party leader for now, but there are talks. The current party leader of the Green Coalition of the Borderlands of Coober Pedi is [b]Susan Fey[/b], the current [b]President of the Senate[/b].

Coober Pedi has no states, instead being ruled directly by the beloved Federal Government. The elected [b]Prime Minister[/b] acts more like a diplomat and general rather than a leader, as Coober Pedi is a direct democracy currently, with the citizens, including the president's single vote, voting on issues. The Prime Minister instead represents the country and can declare war after being elected, but any diplomatic visits or war declarations have to be approved by [b]The Senate[/b], currently led by Susan Fey, an independent known to vote on things that aren't extreme. Coober Pedi also has a judicial system, with the current Grand Judge being [b]Odin Gageler[/b], interestingly being born in northern Nordiheim, rather than in Coober Pedi.[/i]
